scope.mode: 공식 PDF 출처·좌표·배점의 제한된 표본 대조

checks: Recomputed SHA-256, opened every page, and checked page counts for all 12 sampled PDFs.
Checked all 280 sample question numbers at native PDF boxes, clip/page bounds, sequence, and course-year/file identity.
Paired each native [1점] or [3점] word with the preceding question heading in its page column, independently of stored text slices; all 280 audit scores match.
Each sampled social/science/vocation paper has ten 2-point and ten 3-point items; each sampled language paper has ten marked 1-point and twenty unmarked 2-point items; each totals 50.
Native text scan across all 336 PDFs found no 홀수형 or 짝수형 tag and no differing extractable first-page 학년도; all 12 visual samples support single-form labeling.
Verified original Arabic right-to-left, Russian Cyrillic, Chinese and Japanese glyphs in rendered pages; intended blank squares remain identifiable.
Visually checked shared-prompt rectangles for 2018 social-ethics 11–12 and 2018 language-arabic 22–23; both include their full passage and correct question range.
Historical vocational coverage: 5 legacy course IDs each exist only in 2018–2021 (20 papers/400 questions); vocation-career exists only in 2022–2027 (6 papers/120 questions).

targetedCases.note: Slightly indented heading is retained; rendered crop includes number, prompt, all choices and [3점].
Rendered shared rectangle contains the Arabic dialogue; native shared text contains only the range heading because dialogue is an image.
Shared prompt is above both questions; stored common range and rendered rectangle match.
Native headers use historical names 물리Ⅰ/Ⅱ and 법과 정치; these are naming changes, not wrong-course files.

limitations: This is representative source/layout QA, not a semantic taxonomy or answer-key review.
Arabic 2018–2027 first-page year/course headers are not native searchable text; the 2018 sampled header was verified visually. Foreign-language course headers also frequently use outlines/images.
Native text can omit image-based dialogue, diagrams and font-shaped glyphs. Correct source page/rect does not mean a complete text transcription; use original PDF rendering or OCR for content review.

All 336 source form/year scans are native-text checks; comprehensive visual review was limited to the 12 selected papers. Parent builder separately revalidates all 316 new paper SHA/ranges/50-point totals.
Manifest URLs and file identities were retained; official remote files were not redownloaded in this bounded local QA.
